title: Picking up 'a mountaineer's ice axe' silently replaced the belt knife as the active weapon in later combat-option labels ('attack ... with a mountaineer's ice axe') with no message announcing the swap or any choice offered about which weapon to carry.
where: The Avalanche Field (Wardmoor) / read where the drift's thinnest
